selfReview.reason: The whole point of this PR. self-reviewer subagent, 10/10 at 1500x980 on installed build 75849be1 - the first binary ever to carry 5fab9e79 (PR #172). It re-confirmed the stamp with its own get_build_stamp probe before capturing anything rather than trusting the ship report. It proved on screen what 16 mounted tests structurally cannot see: the roving-tabindex focus ring draws OUTSIDE the swatch fill (outline 2px solid rgb(179,102,255), outline-offset 2px) so it stays legible on a near-hue swatch as well as a contrasting one; disabled-skip and wrap driven with real CDP input events in both directions landed on 'Apply to all rooms' and never the disabled 'Reset to default'; Escape returned focus visibly to the trigger. It also recorded that synthetic DOM dispatch fails Chromium's :focus-visible heuristic and would have FALSE-FAILED the states item. This PR's own diff is documentation only and adds no UI surface of its own.
